loop.purpose: Draft bounded scientific software changes from actual requirements
loop.input: Actual source version, requirements, interface contracts and validation cases
loop.output: Proposed code diff with traceable requirement coverage
loop.check: Scientist reviews scientific logic, numerical behaviour, interfaces, data exposure, edge cases and unsupported dependencies
loop.stop: Missing requirement/reference case or two failed revisions returns coding to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native configuration and existing functions first; new project-specific code paths vary

actual application requirements and validation cases

tasks.design: Use native library/application capabilities first, then bound code drafting in development tools {OTHER} to actual scientific requirements. The scientist retains scientific specification, complete final code review and reference-output validation before committing the exact diff.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scientific software work can repeat code navigation and implementation after requirements exist.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source search and bounded diff drafting can reduce navigation and first implementation.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific correctness and reliable edge-case behaviour require explicit validation.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist detects a plausible implementation that changes the biological meaning.
tasks.altitude: Less initial implementation; scientific validation remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source navigation and bounded code drafting can support scientific software changes; generated code does not establish scientific validity.

assumptions: Actual project scientists supply question/data and scientist captures requirements and validation cases in s1. Actual repository owner supplies source/interfaces; checks remain in s2/s4. Missing scientific reference cases remain manual, not invented.
Retained s3 includes requirement clarification, generated-diff correction and implementation exceptions. Full final code/scientific validation remains in s4; runtime is not counted as labour saving.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native configuration/library reuse first; existing automated generation earns zero saving. Routine internal commit retains one percent using existing final diff/test check. Deployment, publication or external code push would be separate actual gated actions, with no saving assumed.
unknowns: Which new code effort is repetitive?
research_questions: Does bounded drafting reduce implementation after complete scientific validation?

already_counted.description: Clarify and correct actual scientific implementation meaning within s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual code-drafting constraints and scientific validation cases.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final code diff and actual validation results for exact internal repository/branch; edits require rerun/recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 navigation + 30*0.40 implementation = 18; minus 2 upkeep = 16. Half eligible gives 9 minus 2 = 7. Requirements, full final validation and commit retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.design: Configure native reusable queries in {DATA_PLATFORM} and bioinformatics analysis tools {OTHER}. The scientist defines exact operations, resolves scientific exceptions and checks the final transformation before committing only an authorised derived dataset.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated query setup can precede biological data manipulation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parameterised queries can reuse explicitly chosen transformations.
tasks.still_hard: Biological identity, annotation meaning and source rights require expert checks.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognises an identifier mapping that is syntactically valid but biologically wrong.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated query setup; biological reconciliation stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native parameterised queries can reuse biological database transformations; they do not resolve scientific identifier ambiguity or source permissions.

assumptions: Actual database providers supply versions, identifiers, annotations and access terms; scientist checks them in s1. Scientist chooses actual joins/filters and captures new specifications within retained s2; missing definitions remain manual.
Only repeated manual query setup loses time. Existing query pipelines and compute runtime earn zero saving. Actual scientific manipulation/exception resolution and final diff checks remain retained.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native queries first. Commit is one percent, fully retained using existing final check. Public/commercial source databases are read only unless actual write authority exists; no source correction, external update or deletion is assumed.
Read-only manipulation removes unused internal commit branch and reweights actual work. Shared derived dataset capture is counted once with actual research.
research_questions: Can native queries reduce setup after complete biological identity checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual query specifications and biological mapping checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final transformation diff and exact authorised internal dataset destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25*0.40 repeated query setup = 10; minus 1 upkeep = 9. Half eligible gives 5 minus 1 = 4. Scientific reconciliation, final checks and commit retained.

tasks.short: Develop biological data models and databases.

inputs: actual biological use cases and data dictionaries
actual source records and access requirements

inputs: actual conceptual data model and scientific requirements
actual platform schema conventions
outputs: draft actual schema definitions and constraints

inputs: draft actual schema definitions and constraints
actual permitted test records and loading mappings
outputs: draft actual database build and loading specification

steps.what: Validate final data model, database constraints, scientific queries and exact proposed schema change
inputs: draft actual database build and loading specification
actual conceptual data model and scientific requirements

inputs: checked final database/schema change and actual validation results

tasks.design: Configure native schema definition and loading-scaffold functions in {DATA_PLATFORM} and database development tools {OTHER}. The scientist defines biological meaning, checks actual mappings and fully validates final database definitions before an internal development commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Database development can repeat schema and loading-scaffold entry after model decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native model-to-schema and loading functions can reuse explicit definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Correct biological entities, provenance and scientific query semantics require modelling judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist notices when a convenient schema loses a biologically meaningful relationship.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated physical database implementation; scientific modelling stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native schema and loading-scaffold functions can implement explicit database definitions; they do not determine valid biological data models.

assumptions: Actual project/source owners supply biological use cases, dictionaries and permitted test records. Scientist defines conceptual model in s1; new physical schema choices and actual loading mappings remain in retained s2/s3.

Only repeated definition/scaffold entry loses time. Existing schema generation, database execution and loading runtime earn zero saving. Complete final scientific query/constraint validation remains retained.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native design functions first. Commit retains one percent and uses the existing final change/test check. This is internal development, not an assumed production migration or external release.

Any actual production schema application needs its own exact-final-migration approval/commit and actual rollback validation; no avoided labour or production authority is assumed here. Shared application work under 16786 is counted once.
research_questions: Can native generation reduce implementation after full biological model validation?

incremental.description: Maintain actual schema generation conventions and scientific validation cases.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final database definition diff and validation results for exact internal development destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 schema entry + 20*0.50 scaffold entry = 18; minus 1.5 upkeep = 16.5. Half eligible gives 9 minus 1.5 = 7.5. Conceptual modelling, full validation and commit retained.
